CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_customer_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT id FROM public.customers WHERE auth_user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_delivery_can_record_payment(_org uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
     AND _org IS NOT NULL
     AND _org IS NOT DISTINCT FROM public.current_org_id()
     AND COALESCE((
          public.has_permission('finance','payments','create')
       OR public.has_permission('finance','invoices','create')
       OR public.has_permission('finance','approve')
       OR public.has_permission('finance','collections','collect_payment')
       OR public.has_permission('finance','collections','settle_bill')
       OR public.has_permission('finance','collections','issue_receipt')
       OR public.is_org_admin_for(_org)
     ), false);
$function$

functions.arguments: _order uuid, _amount numeric, _method text DEFAULT 'cash'::text, _entry_type text DEFAULT 'payment'::text, _reference text DEFAULT NULL::text, _reason text DEFAULT NULL::text, _account uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_gl_account_code(_org uuid, _method text, _account uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_code text;
  v_method text := lower(coalesce(replace(_method, '-', '_'), ''));
BEGIN
  IF _org IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  -- Card proceeds belong in Card Clearing until the acquirer actually
  -- settles them into the nominated bank account.
  --
  -- Keep _account on the source payment for later settlement/reconciliation,
  -- but deliberately do not use it as the sale-side debit account.
  IF v_method IN ('card', 'card_terminal', 'credit_card', 'debit_card') THEN
    RETURN public.neo_gl_settlement_code_for(_org, _method);
  END IF;

  -- Other recorded tenders retain the existing destination-account behaviour.
  -- For example, a bank transfer already received into a specific bank account
  -- may post directly to that account.
  IF _account IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT a.code
      INTO v_code
      FROM public.bank_accounts b
      JOIN public.chart_of_accounts a
        ON a.id = b.gl_account_id
     WHERE b.id = _account
       AND b.organization_id = _org
       AND a.organization_id = _org
       AND coalesce(b.active, true)
       AND a.active
       AND coalesce(a.postable, true)
       AND coalesce(a.is_header, false) = false;

    IF v_code IS NOT NULL THEN
      RETURN v_code;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN public.neo_gl_settlement_code_for(_org, _method);
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_gl_cash_code(_org uuid, _method text, _account uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.neo_gl_account_code(_org, _method, _account)
$function$
